newsitem.title: HONG KONG: EAC says buy-in approved by shareholders.
newsitem.headline: EAC says buy-in approved by shareholders.

text.p: East Asiatic Co (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Thursday shareholders approved a buy-in at HK$1.30 per share of the 25 percent minority not held by Denmark's East Asiatic Co Ltd .
Trading in shares of the firm was earlier suspended in the Hong Kong stock exchange. The shares closed on Tuesday at HK$1.26.
The proposal also included an option for shareholders to take shares in the parent company instead of cash, it said.
The scheme would now go before the Supreme Court of Hong Kong for sanctioning, it said, adding if successful, the company would be delisted from the Hong Kong stock exchange.
East Asiatic is engaged in a range of trading activities including importing, marketing and distributing of machinery, equipment and consumer products. Its key markets are Hong Kong, Macau and China.
